title: persistent() should reject state_root == floor_root to enforce separate-roots invariant
description: Found by security codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-s6ml. AnnounceTrustStore::persistent (announce_store.rs:121-136) accepts identical or nested state_root/floor_root without complaint, while the anti-rollback story (module doc :10-13) and the heal safety rationale lean on the caller passing distinct roots; a single-snapshot rewind of a shared root loads fine today. The existing test at :683 even passes the same path twice. Hardening: in persistent(), reject state_root == floor_root (and ideally a prefix/nesting check) with Err(Io) or a new error variant, and fix the affected test to pass distinct roots.
